notes.title: Female Protagonist - Scene Teaser
notes.notes:
Here’s the promised female Alex teaser! In this scene, Alex corners a vampire during a pursuit. However, a brief moment of hesitation is all it takes for the tables to turn—suddenly, the hunter becomes the prey.

Help us unlock the female protagonist by backing our Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bloodcrave/bloodcrave-horror-visual-novel
